adapterCapabilities.title: Adapter capability evidence
adapterCapabilities.disclaimer: {{adapter}}: repository evidence only, not this account’s live qualification. C2 fixtures are not C3 tenant or C4 business acceptance. Installing an adapter does not upgrade its status.
adapterCapabilities.notQualified: No evidence ledger is registered for this adapter. Unknown does not mean unsupported.
adapterCapabilities.qoderLocal: Real Linux child-process lifecycle with a fake CLI; official CLI availability checked, real inference untested.
adapterCapabilities.noRemote: This adapter only starts a local process; remote workspace execution is not implemented.
adapterCapabilities.qoderSession: Fixture-tested isolation by company, Agent, task, workspace and credential identity; no latest-session fallback.
adapterCapabilities.qoderStop: Linux process-group termination is fixture-tested. Real provider and Windows cancellation are not qualified.
adapterCapabilities.noToolApproval: The CLI bridge does not implement dynamic tool approval. It does not bypass provider permissions.
adapterCapabilities.noRoundTrip: No verified remote code/workspace round-trip synchronization.
adapterCapabilities.unpricedUsage: Unknown cost stays unpriced, not zero. Credits are not USD; no reliable monetary conversion is claimed.
adapterCapabilities.remoteOnly: This bridge uses the cloud API; it does not control an installed WorkBuddy desktop client.
adapterCapabilities.workbuddyRemote: OAuth/job/ACP/report contracts have controlled tests. Real app approval, account and cloud task remain unverified.
adapterCapabilities.workbuddySession: Persisted job/session recovery is fixture-tested. Unknown creates are not blindly repeated.
adapterCapabilities.noRemoteStop: Stopping the local bridge does not prove that the remote provider stopped.
adapterCapabilities.denyToolApproval: Permission requests are denied by default; no qualified human-approval round trip.
